news_references.title: Centrica brings electricity generation capacity to 4GW in £370m deal
Industrial decarbonisation delay putting ‘billions’ of UK investment at risk, trade bodies warn

insights.summary: UK’s electricity generation capacity is expanding via Centrica’s £370m acquisition, while trade bodies warn delayed industrial decarbonisation risks billions in investment. GB demand remains stable at 25,118 MW, but policy gaps may hinder transition progress.
insights.title: GB Renewable Capacity Expansion Amid Industrial Decarbonisation Urgency
validation_notes: Centrica’s acquisition aligns with GB’s 2030 net-zero targets but lacks explicit decarbonisation tech (e.g., hydrogen/CCS) integration details.
Trade body warnings correlate with delayed UK Industrial Strategy updates (e.g., CCS funding delays).
